matched: Plant location in Tianjin receiving water from Luanhe River (Dec-Feb) and Yangtze River (Mar-Nov from Danjiangkou)
Treatment train: pre-treatment, enhanced conventional treatment, UV + chlorine disinfection
Capacity 17.5 wt/d and stable hydraulic retention time 25.56 min
Dual coagulants (ferric chloride in pretreatment, PACl in blending) with difference <= 5 mg/L; PACl selected as single target
1339 daily observations (Oct 2022 to May 2024), split 8:2 into 1071 training and 268 test samples
Input features: WTR, T, pH, NTU, EC, CODMn for RW and TW, plus NH3-N for RW only
KNN (k=4) imputation selected via grid search (k=1-10) minimizing MSE, effectively handling non-random missing parameters (T, NH3-N)
Moving average filter (n=5) selected via autocorrelation function (ACF) to eliminate noise while preserving peak dynamics
Spearman rank correlation coefficient (rs) feature selection reducing dimensionality and enhancing generalization
AutoML concept: automated feature engineering, algorithm selection, and hyperparameter optimization
TPOT framework (v0.11.7) based on genetic programming, dependencies on Scikit-Learn (v1.0.2), DEAP, XGBoost in Python 3.8
TPOT core mechanisms: tree-structured genetic programming, Scikit-Learn multi-algorithm search space, Pareto-optimal pipeline via 3 runs of 10-fold CV
Tree SHAP package in Python 3.9, with supporting packages (Table 1: Sklearn, Scipy, Seaborn, TPOT, SHAP, Matplotlib)
Mean absolute SHAP value for feature ranking and sum of absolute SHAP values for collective environmental impact
SHAP dependency plots for interaction effects, and local decision and waterfall plots for individual sample interpretation
Model evaluation metrics: RMSE (sensitive to outliers), MAE (mean error magnitude), R2 (goodness of fit) with complete formulas
